name: X.com MCP Server
description: Model Context Protocol server that enables LLMs to interact with X.com (formerly Twitter) through OAuth 2.0 authentication, supporting major Post-related operations including reading, writing, searching, and managing posts, likes, retweets, and bookmarks.
